code:
-- Clinic billing export, August 2026: $2,151,980

SELECT SUM(total_billed_usd)
FROM harborview.gold.claims_summary_gold
WHERE claim_date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31';
-- $2,114,860   (short by $37,120)
caption: A repeatable shortfall, not a rounding difference -- and a shortfall, not an overcount.

code:
SELECT claim_id, clinic_id, claim_amount_usd
FROM harborview.silver.claims_clean
WHERE claim_date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  AND claim_amount_usd < 0;
-- 14 rows, all clinic_id = 'CLINIC-11'
-- totaling exactly -$37,120
caption: Negative claim amounts that claims_clean's own rules were built to catch.
